Fixes:
- The project's attachments archive (`<project>_attachments.zip`) is now copied with `.qgs` projects, even though the default skip list contains `*.zip`
- Line breaks and tabs inside project attributes (multi-line expressions, map tips, label rules) are preserved; previously the backed-up project flattened them to spaces
- Whitespace-only values in the project (for example a single-space delimiter) are preserved
- Backing up again into the same destination now refreshes folder datasources instead of keeping the earlier, possibly outdated copy
- A file that could not be read completely, or whose data could not be written to disk (for example, disk full), is now reported as a failed copy instead of a success
- The backup is never copied into itself when the destination lies inside a folder datasource
- Raster and metadata sidecars such as `.tif.aux.xml`, `.tif.ovr` and `.shp.xml` are copied with their datasource
- Files from different folders that share a basename (e.g. `roads.shp` and `roads.gpkg`) no longer overwrite each other's sidecars
- PostGIS, WFS and other connection strings are no longer reported as missing files
- SpatiaLite databases referenced with `dbname='...'` are now backed up and the layer points to the copy
